author: LivePaper
description: Bells, fringed discs, frilly-armed drifters and shimmering comb jellies pulse, glow and slowly rise or sink on minutes-long journeys at every depth of the deep night ocean, trailing lagging tentacles through three depths of drifting marine snow, swaying moonlight shafts under a faint rippling net of surface light, slow plankton-glow haze, softly flaring bioluminescent sparks and passing waves of plankton light.
name: Abyssal Lanterns
